question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Noble
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word '**Noble**' means honest; full of courage and care for others; belonging to the highest social class.(महान, सज्जन)

 
 
• **Example **- He was a **noble **man with a kind heart and a strong sense of justice.
 
 
 
• '**Common**' means happening or often found or in many places; usual.(सामान्य, साधारण)
 
 
• **Example **- English is a **common **language in many countries.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the antonym of '**Noble**' is '**Common**'.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is '**Common**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences.

 
• **Grand **(भव्य, शानदार) - Impressive and large or important.

 
 
• **Example **- She threw a **grand **party for her birthday.
 
 
 
• **Indescribable **(अवर्णनीय) - Too good or bad to be described
 
 
• **Example **- The painting captured an **indescribable **sense of peace.
 
 
 
• **Magical **(दिलकश, मनोहर) - That seems to use magic; wonderful and exciting.
 
 
• **Example **- There is one **magical **moment in the film when they meet for the first time.
 
 

3f:Tbd3,

The correct answer is **Option 3.**
